Safety Officer Job at New Hope Liuhe




        
    

        
        New Hope Liuhe also known as New Hope Agric and Tech is an agricultural feed manufacturing industry, producing chicken feed, pig feed and also fish feed.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Safety Officer
Job Location: Logbara, Ogun
Employment Type: Full-time 

Job Summary


	A Safety Officer is responsible for ensuring workplace safety, compliance with regulations, and minimizing risks by implementing safety programs, conducting inspections, and training employees.


Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Compliance & Policy Enforcement: Ensure adherence to Occupational Health and Safety (OHS) laws and company policies.Develop and update safety procedures tailored to manufacturing operations.
	Risk Assessment & Hazard Control: Identify potential hazards in machinery, processes, and materials. Conduct regular risk assessments and recommend corrective measures.
	Training & Awareness: Organisesafety training sessions and workshops for employees.Promote a culture of safety through awareness campaigns.


Requirements


	Interested candidates should possess a Bachelor`s Degree with 2 years of experience.


Salary
N150,000 monthly.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.

Factor Admin / HR Job at Ascentech Services Limited




        
    

        
        Ascentech Services Limited is a human resources solutions company dedicated to helping businesses build stronger teams and manage people functions more effectively. Established in Nigeria in 2013, we have supported organizations for years with high-quality, practical HR services designed to meet real business needs; adapting to evolving workforce demands and enabling long-term growth. With a strong presence in Lagos and Ibadan, and an expanding footprint through Ascentforce in India, we deliver a broader, more connected approach to recruitment, outsourcing, training, and ongoing HR support. Ascentech brings expertise across borders, backed by over 13 years of dedicated experience in delivering practical HR and recruitment solutions. 
     

            
    



We are  recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Factor Admin / HR
Job Location: Ilupeju, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Key Responsibilities


	Coordinate daily administrative and factory support activities.
	Maintain accurate records of staff attendance, shifts, leave, and overtime.
	Prepare reports, correspondence, and other administrative documents.
	Support procurement, inventory, and office supplies management.
	Maintain records of production, dispatch, deliveries, and factory expenses.
	Coordinate communication between production, warehouse, finance, HR, and management.
	Monitor office and factory administrative expenses.
	Assist with vendor, supplier, and service provider coordination.
	Ensure proper filing and documentation of factory records.
	Support management with other administrative and operational tasks as required.


Requirements


	Possess a Bachelor’s Degree / HND in Business Administration, Management, or related field with 3 – 5 years of experiencein administration, preferably in a manufacturing / FMCG environment.
	Good knowledge ofMicrosoft Office, particularly Excel.
	Strong organizational, communication, and coordination skills.
	Ability to multitask and work in afast-paced factory environment.
	High attention to detail and good record-keeping skills.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should forward their CVs to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.

  "description": "Kaplo is Africa&#39;s most innovative Human Resource &amp; Business Support Solutions provider, serving clients with cutting-edge business advisory and human capital solutions across diverse sectors of the African economy.

At Kaplo, we have proven expertise in business advisory and human resource capabilities targeted at productivity, profitability, sustainability, transformation and overall growth of your business.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:&nbsp;

&nbsp;Job Position: Senior Accountant / Head of Finance

Job Location: Lagos

Backend Developer Job at Accretio Africa




        
    

        
        Accretio Africa, a HR Consulting Firm, is recruiting to fill the position below: 

 Job Position: Backend Developer

Job Location: Abuja (FCT)
Employment Type: Full-time
Work Mode: Hybrid

Role Overview
     

            
    




	The Backend Developer will be responsible for building, integrating, and maintaining secure and reliable backend systems and APIs.
	The ideal candidate will have strong experience with Java and Spring Boot, database management, API development, and transaction-based systems, with exposure to fintech or payment solutions being an advantage.


What You'll Do


	Design, develop, and maintain backend applications and REST APIs using Java, Spring Boot, and related technologies.
	Build and integrate APIs while working with relational databases, JPA/Hibernate, authentication, authorization, and secure API practices.
	Develop and maintain reliable transaction processing systems, including handling failed transactions, reversals, duplicates, settlement, reconciliation, and transaction integrity.
	Write, test, debug, and maintain production-ready code while supporting system performance and reliability.
	Collaborate with the CTO, MD, and cross-functional teams to deliver secure and scalable backend solutions.


Who You Are


	Possess a Bachelor's Degree with 4 – 5 years of backend development experience, with strong proficiency in Java and Spring Boot.
	Strong experience with REST APIs, SQL / relational databases, JPA / Hibernate, Git, authentication / authorization, testing, error handling, and transaction management.
	Experience with Node.js / TypeScript, Python, C# / .NET, or equivalent backend technologies is an advantage.
	Good understanding of payment flows, transaction processing, API security, webhooks, and secure software development.
	Experience with Docker, CI / CD, or cloud platforms is an advantage, with strong debugging and production support skills.


Why Join Them?


	Salary: N500,000 - N550,000 monthly
	Work on technology solutions within the growing fintech and payments space.
	Build and maintain backend systems that support secure and reliable financial transactions.
	Collaborate closely with the CTO, MD, and cross-functional teams.
	Gain exposure to payment flows, transaction processing, settlement, and reconciliation.
